meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 它把你的 cmem.ai 凭据(同步令牌、user id、SyncHub URL)写进插件的 config.json,让钩子能捕获并注入记忆;随后用 status 命令检查配对结果,输出打码显示。令牌只经文件读写传递,不会在对话里回显。
howto.when: 当你要求「set up claude-mem」「pair claude-mem」等说法,或直接粘贴 cmem.ai Connect 里的同步令牌、user id、SyncHub URL 时触发。

say.text: 帮我配对 claude-mem,同步令牌是 cm_xxx
say.note: 写入 config.json,令牌不会回显

say.text: 连接 cmem,user id 和 SyncHub URL 我发给你
检查一下 cmem 配对状态
say.note: 运行 status,返回打码结果

howto.what_en: It writes your cmem.ai credentials (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) into the plugin's config.json so hooks can capture and inject memory, then checks the pairing with a masked status command.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", or paste cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL).

say_en.text: Pair claude-mem for me; my sync token is cm_xxx
say_en.note: Writes config.json; token is never echoed

say_en.text: Connect cmem; here are my user id and SyncHub URL
say_en.note: All three values go into the plugin config
Runs status and shows masked output
